description: Tests de résistance des antivols vélo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Fédération des Usagères et Usagers de la Bicyclette. Description Protecting your bike with an anti-theft is a well-known reality for every cyclist. Getting your bike stolen canbe a shock anddiscourage you from continuing to pedal. To support cyclists, the FUB has implemented citizen expertise around anti-theft bike tests since 2002. Coverage: Fédération des Usagères et Usagers de la Bicyclette. The portal shows the English title as "Tests of resistance of anti-theft bicycles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Fédération des Usagères et Usagers de la Bicyclette. Its keywords include fub-2-roues, antivol-velo, test-antivol. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-03-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
